doc.title: Lou Marini interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 15, 2023

title: John Coltrane and being in the zone
summary: Coltrane walking a bar, a producer's story of seeing Trane, Dizzy on ego and the free trust in Coltrane's quartet.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: It sounds great to me, you’ve got me smiling. And I know what you’re talking about, the interaction between musicians is something special. I’ll wrap up here, because this has just been marvelous — with a couple of things — I may be the only person who saw you when I saw you walk the counter with Aretha Franklin that I was reminded that apparently John Coltrane also walked a bar.
Wow. Well you know it’s — I think Coltrane is like a — like I understand why there’s a church of Coltrane out in San Francisco you know, because who’s the record producer? © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-

He used to do a lot of jazz, a big guy, had a beard, I worked for him a bunch of times. His name is escaping me now, but he told me he saw Trane one night with the band with Pharaoh Sanders and towards the end of Trane’s life. And he said at one point Trane stopped playing and was beating on his chest in the music you know. Those glimpses that we have of — I mentioned earlier something about when you’re sometimes when you’re really playing and you’re in a different place if your ego comes in you crash to earth. But I remember talking to Dizzy about that. And Dizzy said it’s only happened to him a few times in his life. So you think somebody as great as Dizzy Gillespie saying that and I think that one thing about Coltrane was somehow he was in that place all the time you know, and that quartet was in that place. I was listening to that record that came out this year of alternate takes, or of unreleased. And they’re just titled “Original #1” “Original #2.” And you hear how free that band was and how they — you can only play that way when there’s ultimate trust between the players. When nobody is bullshitting in any way. When it’s just letting go you know.
